automotive-seo.title: Automotive SEO — Rank Higher on Google
automotive-seo.text: Improve organic search visibility for relevant automotive services and location-based keywords that potential customers are searching for.
automotive-seo.h1: Automotive SEO in Malaysia: rank higher on Google
automotive-seo.meta: Automotive SEO for Malaysian workshops, dealers, tyre shops and parts suppliers: service and location pages that match what motorists search on Google.
automotive-seo.why: Most motorists start with a search like “car service near me” or “tyre shop Shah Alam”. If your website doesn’t have a clear page for that service in that area, Google has nothing of yours to show. Automotive SEO gives each service and each area you cover a page that answers the search properly.
covers: Keyword research on the services and areas your customers actually search for, in English and Bahasa Malaysia
One clear page for each main service, with the details a motorist needs before they call
Location pages for the areas you really serve, such as Petaling Jaya, Shah Alam, Johor Bahru or George Town
Technical checks: page speed, mobile layout, titles, headings, broken links and indexing
Structured data (schema) so Google understands your business, services and FAQs
Regular review of what is working in Google Search Console, and changes based on it

faqs.q: How long does automotive SEO take to work?
faqs.a: SEO builds over months, not days. Technical fixes and new service pages can be picked up by Google within weeks, while stronger rankings for competitive searches usually take longer. We don’t promise specific rankings or dates, because Google decides those.

faqs.q: Do you target Bahasa Malaysia searches too?
faqs.a: Yes, where your customers use them. Many motorists search in a mix of English and Bahasa Malaysia, such as “bengkel kereta” or “kedai tayar”, so we check both when we plan your pages.

faqs.q: Do I need a new website for SEO?
faqs.a: Not always. If your current website is sound, we improve it. If it is slow, hard to use on a phone or hard to edit, we may suggest a rebuild. We’ll explain which after the free audit.

aeo-answer-engine-optimisation.title: AEO — Get Discovered Through Answer Engines
aeo-answer-engine-optimisation.text: Structure automotive content to improve its eligibility for Google featured snippets, AI-generated answers and conversational search.
aeo-answer-engine-optimisation.h1: AEO for automotive businesses: be the answer people see
aeo-answer-engine-optimisation.meta: Answer Engine Optimisation for Malaysian automotive businesses: clear answers to motorists’ questions, structured for featured snippets and AI answers.
aeo-answer-engine-optimisation.why: More searches now end with an answer rather than a list of links: a featured snippet, an AI overview or a voice reply. Motorists ask things like “how often should I change my gearbox oil?” or “why is my car aircon not cold?”. AEO makes sure your business has a clear, accurate answer ready, so you can be the source those answers draw on.
covers: A list of the real questions your customers ask, before and after they visit
Short, direct answers at the top of each page, followed by the detail
FAQ sections on service pages, marked up with FAQ schema
Plain headings that match how people phrase their questions
Facts kept consistent across your website and Google Business Profile
searches: how often to service a car in Malaysia
why is my car aircon not cold
what does a car battery cost

faqs.q: What is the difference between SEO and AEO?
faqs.a: SEO helps your pages rank in the list of search results. AEO shapes your content so search engines and AI tools can lift a clear answer from it, for featured snippets, AI overviews and voice search. They work best together.

faqs.q: Will AEO get my business into Google’s AI answers?
faqs.a: Nobody can guarantee that, because Google and AI tools choose their own sources. AEO improves your eligibility by giving them clear, well-structured and accurate answers to use.

faqs.q: Do I have to write the answers myself?
faqs.a: No. We draft them from what you tell us about your services and how you work, and you check them for accuracy before they go live.

geo-ai-search-visibility.title: GEO — Build Visibility in AI Search
geo-ai-search-visibility.text: Strengthen your brand's discoverability and authority across AI-powered search experiences, including ChatGPT, Google Gemini and Perplexity.
geo-ai-search-visibility.h1: GEO in Malaysia: get your automotive business into AI search
geo-ai-search-visibility.meta: Generative Engine Optimisation for automotive businesses in Malaysia: help ChatGPT, Google Gemini and Perplexity find, understand and mention your brand.
geo-ai-search-visibility.why: Some motorists now ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity to recommend a workshop or explain a repair before they ever open Google. These tools build their answers from what they can read and trust about you online. GEO makes your business facts clear, consistent and easy for AI tools to find.
covers: Clear business facts on your website: what you do, where, and for which vehicles
The same name, contact link and areas everywhere your business appears online
An llms.txt file and clean structured data that AI tools can read
Search engine setup on Google and Bing, which several AI tools draw on
Helpful guides and FAQs that give AI tools something accurate to quote
Checks on how AI tools currently describe your business
searches: best tyre shop in Johor Bahru
recommend a car aircon specialist in Penang
where to buy car parts in Selangor

faqs.q: What is GEO?
faqs.a: Generative Engine Optimisation is the work of making your business easy for AI tools such as ChatGPT, Google Gemini and Perplexity to find, understand and mention when people ask them for recommendations or advice.

faqs.q: Can you guarantee ChatGPT will recommend my business?
faqs.a: No. AI tools decide their own answers and they change over time. What we can do is make sure accurate, consistent information about your business is out there for them to use.

faqs.q: Does GEO replace SEO?
faqs.a: No. AI tools often rely on the same pages and signals that search engines use, so good SEO is the base that GEO builds on.

automotive-website-design.text: Create professional, mobile-friendly, SEO-ready websites designed to turn visitors into WhatsApp enquiries, phone calls and confirmed bookings.

automotive-website-design.meta: Mobile-friendly, SEO-ready websites for Malaysian workshops, dealers and automotive suppliers, designed to turn visitors into WhatsApp enquiries and bookings.

faqs.q: How much does a website cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the number of pages and what you need. WhatsApp us for a quote after we understand your business.

faqs.q: Can you improve my existing website instead?
faqs.a: Yes. If your current site is in good shape, we can fix its speed, layout and SEO rather than rebuild it.

faqs.q: Will the website be mine?
faqs.a: Yes. The website is built for your business on your own domain.

google-maps-local-seo.title: Google Maps & Local SEO
google-maps-local-seo.text: Optimise Google Business Profiles to improve local discoverability, strengthen customer trust and attract nearby motorists.
google-maps-local-seo.h1: Google Maps and local SEO for automotive businesses in Malaysia
google-maps-local-seo.meta: Google Business Profile and local SEO for Malaysian workshops, tyre shops, detailers and dealers: be easier to find on Google Maps when nearby motorists search.
google-maps-local-seo.why: When a motorist searches “tyre shop near me”, Google usually shows a map with a handful of businesses before any website. Your Google Business Profile decides whether you appear there and whether people trust you enough to tap. Local SEO keeps that profile complete, accurate and active.
covers: A complete Google Business Profile: the right categories, services, hours and service areas
Your business name and details kept the same on your profile, website and directories
Regular profile posts and photos that show your real work
A simple routine for asking happy customers for Google reviews, and replying to reviews
Location pages on your website that support your Maps listing

faqs.q: Why doesn’t my business show on Google Maps?
faqs.a: Common reasons are an unverified or incomplete profile, the wrong main category, or details that don’t match your website. The free audit checks these first.

faqs.q: Can you get us more Google reviews?
faqs.a: We set up an easy, honest way to ask your real customers for reviews. We never buy reviews or write fake ones, as that breaks Google’s rules and can get a profile suspended.

faqs.q: Do I need a shop address to appear on Maps?
faqs.a: No. Mobile services can use a service-area profile that lists the areas they cover instead of a public address.

faqs.q: Who writes the content?
faqs.a: We draft it based on your services and expertise, and you approve anything that states facts about your business before it goes live.

faqs.q: How often should we publish?
faqs.a: Regular, useful content does better than bursts. We agree a pace that suits your business when we plan the work.

faqs.q: Will you copy content from other websites?
faqs.a: No. Copied content doesn’t help with Google or AI search. Everything is written for your business.

faqs.q: What does AutoSEO.my do?
faqs.a: AutoSEO.my helps automotive businesses in Malaysia get found online. We combine SEO, AEO and GEO so workshops, dealers, tyre shops and other automotive businesses are easier to find on Google Search, Google Maps and AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity, and easier to contact on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: Who do you work with?

faqs.q: Which areas do you cover?
faqs.a: We work with businesses across Malaysia, including Kuala Lumpur, Selangor, Johor Bahru and Penang. Strategies are built around the areas where your customers are.

faqs.a: SEO helps your pages rank on Google. AEO shapes your content into clear answers for featured snippets and AI answers. GEO helps AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity find and mention your business. Together they cover how motorists search today.

notfound_page.lead: The link may be old or mistyped. Try the services or industries pages, or ask us on WhatsApp.

check._note: Free website check in the homepage hero (templates/hero_check.html + assets/check.js). {site} and {score} are filled in by the script.
check.label: Your website address
check.note: Free, about 20 seconds. We only read your public homepage.
check.err_empty: Please enter your website address, for example yourworkshop.com.my
check.err_failed: We couldn't check that website. Check the address and try again.
check.err_blocked: This website uses bot protection that hides it from automated checkers, so we can't score it fairly.
check.err_rate: You've run a lot of checks recently. Please try again in an hour.
check.err_network: The check couldn't run just now. Please try again in a minute.
check.verdict_good: A strong start. A few small fixes could still help.
check.verdict_poor: Several basics are missing, so motorists may not find you.
check.penalty: Score held at {cap} because of a serious problem: {items}. Fix this first.

penalty_items.indexable: the page is hidden from Google (noindex)
penalty_items.title: the page has no title

check.speed_na: Mobile speed couldn't be measured right now.
check.wa_heading: Want to know what to fix first?
check.wa_text: Send this result to our team on WhatsApp and we'll reply with the fixes that matter most. No obligation.
check.wa_button: Get my fix list on WhatsApp
check.wa_failed_text: Send us your website address on WhatsApp and our team will check it for you.
check.disclaimer: An automated check of your homepage. It shows what to improve; it can't promise rankings.

status.label: Page loads
status.fix: Your homepage did not load properly. Google can't list a page that doesn't open.

https.label: Secure (HTTPS)
https.pass: Your site uses a secure https:// address.
https.fix: Your site isn't on https://. Browsers show "Not secure" and Google prefers secure sites.

http_redirect.label: http:// goes to https://
http_redirect.pass: Visitors who type http:// are sent to the secure version.
http_redirect.fix: The http:// version doesn't send visitors to https://.

title.label: Page title
title.pass: Your page title is a good length.
title.fix: Your page title is missing, too short or too long. It's the blue headline people see on Google.

description.label: Meta description
description.pass: Your search snippet text is a good length.
description.fix: Your meta description is missing or the wrong length, so Google may show random text under your name.

h1.label: Main heading (H1)
h1.fix: The page needs exactly one main heading that says what you do and where.

local_keywords.label: Your area in the title and heading
local_keywords.pass: Your title and heading say where you work.
local_keywords.fix: Say your area in the title and main heading, for example "Car Workshop in Petaling Jaya".

lang.label: Page language set
lang.pass: The page says which language it's in.
lang.fix: The page doesn't say which language it's in, so Google has to guess.

mixed_content.label: No insecure files
mixed_content.pass: All images and scripts load securely.
mixed_content.fix: Some images or scripts load over insecure http://, which browsers can block.

indexable.label: Allowed in Google
indexable.pass: Nothing stops Google from listing this page.
indexable.fix: This page tells Google not to list it (noindex), so it won't show up in search.

canonical.label: Canonical link
canonical.pass: Google knows which address is the main version.
canonical.fix: No canonical link, so Google may treat copies of the page as separate pages.

robots.label: robots.txt
robots.pass: Found, and it lets Google in.
robots.fix: robots.txt is missing or blocks Google.

sitemap.label: Sitemap
sitemap.pass: A sitemap helps Google find every page.
sitemap.fix: No sitemap found, so Google may miss some of your pages.

pages.label: Enough pages to rank
pages.pass: Enough pages to show up for many different searches.
pages.fix: Too few pages. Each service and area usually needs its own page to show up on Google.

internal_links.label: Links to your other pages
internal_links.pass: The homepage links to your other pages.
internal_links.fix: Link from the homepage to each service and area page so Google and visitors find them.

fresh.label: Site looks up to date
fresh.fix: The site looks out of date (old footer year or no recent updates).

viewport.label: Mobile-friendly setup
viewport.fix: The page isn't set up for phones, and most motorists search on their phone.

response.label: Server response time
response.fix: Your server is slow to answer, and impatient visitors leave.

weight.label: Page size
weight.fix: The page is heavy, so it loads slowly on mobile data.

scripts.label: Not slowed down by scripts
scripts.fix: Many script files load with the page, which slows it down on phones.

schema.label: Business details for machines (structured data)
schema.pass: Google and AI tools can read your business details.
schema.fix: No business details in structured data, so Google and AI tools have to guess your name, area and hours.

ai_bots.label: AI assistants can read the site
ai_bots.pass: ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and others aren't blocked.
ai_bots.fix: Your robots.txt blocks some AI tools, so they can't recommend you.

content.label: Readable text on the page
content.pass: Enough text for Google and AI to understand what you offer.
content.fix: Too little readable text. Explain your services, areas and common questions in plain words.

h2.label: Subheadings
h2.fix: Use subheadings for each service, area and common question.

faq.label: Answers to common questions (FAQ)
faq.pass: Answers real customer questions that Google and AI can quote.
faq.fix: Add real customer questions with clear answers (price, how long, which areas).

llms.label: llms.txt summary for AI
llms.pass: Found an llms.txt summary for AI tools.
llms.fix: No llms.txt summary. It helps AI tools describe you correctly (nice to have).

og.label: Share preview
og.pass: Links shared on WhatsApp and Facebook show a proper preview.
og.fix: Links shared on WhatsApp and Facebook look bare. Add share preview tags.

alt.label: Photos with descriptions
alt.fix: Add real photos of your work, each with a short description.

local.label: Phone number and location
local.pass: Customers and Google can see where you are and how to reach you.
local.fix: Show your phone number and your address or service area on the page.

contact.label: One-tap contact
contact.pass: Visitors can call, WhatsApp or email you in one tap.
contact.fix: No one-tap call, WhatsApp or email link. Ready customers won't copy your number by hand.

reviews.label: Reviews shown
reviews.pass: Shows reviews that build trust with new customers.
reviews.fix: No reviews on the page. Most motorists check reviews before they call.

hours_map.label: Opening hours and map
hours_map.pass: Customers can see when you're open and find you on Google Maps.
hours_map.fix: Show your opening hours and a Google Maps link.
